Apple’s first foldable iPhone is drawing praise for its sleek engineering and nearly invisible screen crease — but critics say its hefty design, camera compromises and uneven app support make the $1,999 gadget a tough sell for most consumers.

On top of that, early reports indicate the pricey device may be prone to crack.

The iPhone Duo hits stores Friday after drawing an 8.8 out of 10 from Engadget and 7 out of 10 from both The Verge and WIRED.

Engadget called Apple’s long-awaited entry into the foldable market “worth the wait,” while The Verge described it as a “messy, expensive, good time.”

Meanwhile, Wired called it an “astonishingly good first foldable.”

The device unfolds to reveal a 7.6-inch matte display that dramatically reduces glare, while its innovative hinge operates smoothly and holds the screen at different angles.

However, a handful of Reddit posts indicated severe disappointment for some buyers as of Friday afternoon.

“iPhone Duo screen cracked within 6 hours of ownership,” one user complained.

The person said they had taken out the device to show it off to a friend when they “felt something around the internal hinge, underneath the screen.”

“As I continued opening it, I heard an audible crack, and the screen broke right along the hinge,” the post continued. “There were no marks or damage on the inner screen’s surface or the external hinge to suggest anything had been caught or damaged.”

The person zoomed back to an Apple store, where staff gave the customer a new Duo.

Another Reddit user posted a video of a cracked device, commenting: “Looks like some of them are cracking in the exact same area.”

Yet another image of a cracked Duo had the caption, “I’ve seen several iPhone Duos with damage in this exact same spot.”

Still, reviewers sung praises of the device’s titanium construction and smooth folding mechanism.

The crease hasn’t disappeared entirely, however. Several critics noted that it remains visible at certain angles and can still be felt when running a finger across the screen.

Apple’s anti-reflective finish also comes with a trade-off: Colors can appear less vibrant and blacks less deep than on the company’s non-folding premium iPhones.

At 254 grams and 11.3 millimeters thick when folded, the Duo’s bulk emerged as one of the most frequent complaints.

Its relatively small 5.4-inch outer display also drew mixed reactions, with some reviewers praising its compact footprint and others complaining that websites and apps feel cramped on the device.

The Wall Street Journal delivered one of the harshest assessments, describing the device as “Too Much iPhone, Too Little iPad.”

Despite its expansive inner display, the Duo falls short of an iPad when it comes to productivity, with more limited multitasking and keyboard capabilities, according to the Journal.

Software emerged as another major sticking point.

While Apple’s own apps generally make a seamless transition between the folded and unfolded screens, reviewers found that many third-party offerings weren’t properly optimized for the device.

Wired’s Julian Chokkattu described the problem: “Thick, black bars on the sides, with a phone-sized app in the middle of this tablet-like display.”

Engadget’s Sam Rutherford called the gap between optimized and unoptimized apps “the biggest growing pain you’ll face on Apple’s first foldable.”

Even the Duo’s multitasking capabilities have limitations.

Users can run two apps side by side, but Apple’s software restricts them to a fixed 50-50 split, without the freedom to open a third floating window.

“If you have two apps split-screen on the Duo, Apple won’t let you resize one app to be slightly bigger than the other like you can on Android,” Chokkattu wrote in Wired.

“Here, a 50-50 split is always enforced. You can’t add a floating third app when in split-screen either, even though Apple has offered a similar capability on iPads for years.”

Those complaints could ease as developers adapt their apps to the new format.

Wired reported that several popular apps received updates during the device’s testing period, while Creative Strategies said the share of its installed apps optimized for the Duo increased dramatically over roughly six days.

Other shortcomings won’t be fixed with software updates.

“Despite being Apple’s most expensive iPhone, the iPhone Duo does not have its most powerful camera system,” Chance Miller of 9to5Mac wrote.

Its main and ultrawide cameras generally earned favorable marks, but several reviewers found their performance inferior to the iPhone 18 Pro, particularly in low light.

The hidden 4-megapixel camera beneath the inner display also disappointed, with Gizmodo reporting washed-out image quality.

“I hear you: it feels absurd that a $2,000 phone—the most expensive iPhone ever—does not have the most versatile camera system that Apple has to offer,” Gizmodo’s Raymond Wong wrote, adding that he “noticed more lens flares coming off streetlights and more smeared details.”

Still, the folding design offers some novel photographic advantages, including the ability to use the higher-quality rear cameras for selfies while viewing the shot on the outer screen.

Battery life, meanwhile, exceeded the expectations of several reviewers, even if it couldn’t match Apple’s top conventional iPhone.

Tom’s Guide found that the Duo lasted 13 hours and 20 minutes in a continuous 5G web-browsing test using its larger display.

That handily beat the 10 hours and six minutes recorded by Samsung’s Galaxy Z Fold 8, but fell well short of the iPhone 18 Pro Max’s 17 hours and 31 minutes.

Other reviewers reported getting through a typical day without needing to recharge, although intensive use of the larger screen could drain the battery considerably faster.

The divergent ratings reflected less disagreement over the Duo’s strengths and weaknesses than differing views about whether its folding design justifies the compromises.

Tom’s Guide called it the “best designed foldable yet,” while 9to5Mac concluded that a conventional iPhone remains the more practical choice for most consumers.

The Post has sought comment from Apple.

پوشش ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود بیشتر مشاهده کنید. اولین آیفون تاشو اپل به دلیل مهندسی شیک و چروک صفحه نمایش تقریبا نامرئی خود مورد تحسین قرار گرفته است - اما منتقدان می گویند طراحی سنگین آن، نقص های دوربین و پشتیبانی نابرابر از برنامه، این گجت 1999 دلاری را برای اکثر مصرف کنندگان به فروش سختی می رساند. علاوه بر این، گزارش های اولیه ممکن است نشان دهنده قیمت بالای آن در فروشگاه آیفون باشد. رسم 8. 8 از 10 از Engadget و 7 از 10 از هر دو The Verge و WIRED.Engadget ورود اپل به بازار تاشو را "ارزش صبر کردن" خواند، در حالی که The Verge آن را "زمان نامرتب، گران و خوب" توصیف کرد.
در همین حال، Wired آن را "اولین تاشو به طرز شگفت انگیزی خوب" نامید.
دستگاه باز می شود تا 7 را نشان دهد. صفحه نمایش مات 6 اینچی که به طور چشمگیری تابش خیره کننده را کاهش می دهد، در حالی که لولای نوآورانه آن به نرمی کار می کند و صفحه نمایش را در زوایای مختلف نگه می دارد. با این حال، تعداد انگشت شماری از پست های Reddit نشان دهنده ناامیدی شدید برخی از خریداران از بعد از ظهر جمعه بود. یکی از کاربران شکایت کرد: "صفحه نمایش iPhone Duo در عرض 6 ساعت پس از مالکیت ترک خورد." این شخص گفت که وقتی "چیزی را در اطراف لولای داخلی، زیر صفحه نمایش احساس کرد" دستگاه را بیرون آورده بود تا آن را به یکی از دوستانش نشان دهد.
این پست ادامه داد: "در حالی که به باز کردن آن ادامه می دادم، صدای ترک شنیدنی را شنیدم و صفحه نمایش درست در امتداد لولا شکست." "هیچ علامت یا آسیبی در سطح داخلی صفحه نمایش یا لولای خارجی وجود نداشت که نشان دهد چیزی گیر کرده یا آسیب دیده است."
شخص زو

Working 9-5 is not in Martha Stewart’s wheelhouse, apparently.

The homemaking mogul, 85, revealed during a recent podcast appearance that she believes there is “no such thing” as “balance” when asked how she’s able to manage both her personal life with her empire.

“Just get that through your thick skulls. You can’t balance it, it doesn’t balance,” Stewart told financial expert Vivian Tu during a live taping of the “Richer Lives by SoFi” podcast.

“You’re gonna get divorced if you’re going to get divorced. You’re going to get married three times if you’re going to get married three times. It just doesn’t work out,” Stewart said.

“This thing about balance, I don’t know who thought about that, but it just does’t work. Maybe infrequently, and I’m jealous of those people, but they’re all so boring,” she added.

Interestingly enough, this is not the first time that the Martha Stewart Living founder has shared a similar sentiment.

In 2023, Stewart railed against work-from-home policies.

“You can’t possibly get everything done working three days a week in the office and two days remotely,” Stewart told Footwear News at the time.

“Look at the success of France with their stupid … you know, off for August, blah blah blah,” she continued. “That’s not a very thriving country. Should America go down the drain because people don’t want to go back to work?”

In 2013, she revealed that she doesn’t see a difference between her work life and her personal life.

“My life is my job, and my job is my life,” she said at the National Association of Professional Women’s networking conference, per Entrepreneur.

Stewart initially began her career working on Wall Street in the 60s before she decided to open a catering company from her kitchen in Westport, Connecticut. In 1982, she published her first book, which launched her booming career into entertaining.

In 2004, she was sentenced to a five-month term in a West Virginia prison after she was found guilty of four felony counts, including conspiracy and obstruction of justice, related to the sale of a stock.

She served five more months in home confinement as well as two years of supervised probation.

After returning from her stint behind bars, she launched a major career comeback, and has since revealed  the jaw-dropping amount of money she’s made on various deals over the years.

پوشش ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. ظاهراً کار 9 تا 5 در چرخ‌خانه مارتا استوارت نیست. این غول خانه‌داری 85 ساله، در طی یک پادکست اخیر در یک پادکست نشان داد که معتقد است «چیزی به‌عنوان «تعادل» وجود ندارد، وقتی از او پرسیده شد که چگونه می‌تواند هر دو زندگی شخصی‌اش را با امپراتوری‌اش مدیریت کند. «فقط از آن عبور کنید. استوارت در جریان پخش زنده پادکست «زندگی های ثروتمند توسط SoFi» به کارشناس مالی ویویان تو گفت: «اگر بخواهید طلاق بگیرید، طلاق خواهید گرفت. اگر قرار باشد سه بار ازدواج کنید، سه بار ازدواج خواهید کرد. استوارت گفت: «این موضوع در مورد تعادل، من نمی‌دانم چه کسی به آن فکر کرده است، اما کار نمی‌کند. شاید به ندرت، و من به آن افراد حسادت می‌کنم، اما همه آن‌ها خیلی کسل‌کننده هستند.» جالب است که این اولین بار نیست که بنیانگذار مارتا استوارت لیوینگ احساسات مشابهی را به اشتراک می‌گذارد. در سال 2023، استوارت از سیاست‌های کار از خانه انتقاد کرد. استوارت در آن زمان به Footwear News گفت. او ادامه داد: «به موفقیت فرانسه با احمقانه‌هایشان نگاه کنید... می‌دانید، برای اوت، بله‌بله‌بله». "این کشور خیلی پر رونقی نیست. آیا آمریکا باید به این دلیل که مردم نمی خواهند به سر کار خود برگردند، از بین برود؟"
در سال 2013، او فاش کرد که تفاوتی بین زندگی کاری خود نمی بیند

Cardi B is having quite the Barbie birthday.

The performer, who turned 34 on October 11, shared the bright pink luxe accessories she’s gifted herself to celebrate.

“From Belcalis to Cardi B…a gift from me to me!!,” the rapper wrote on Instagram.

First up: an ultra-rare “Barbie” Rolex, which was sourced by jeweler Eric Mavani. Cardi thanked him “for searching all around the world” to find the piece — and it turns out she paid a hefty price.

The jeweler posted proof that the “Bodak Yellow” rapper paid him $2.8 million in two installments for the watch.

Sitting in front of a pink acrylic piano, Cardi was presented with the watch, sharing the video on her own feed. “There’s probably only 10 made in the world,” the jeweler told her as he removed the Rolex Barbie Daytona watch from its green case.

But the gifts didn’t stop there; she also purchased an Hermès mini Kelly in bubblegum pink matte alligator and a custom diamond ring.

While the price on the Kelly wasn’t disclosed, it has previously sold for $200,000 on the secondary market.

As for the ring, it’s a 7-carat natural marquise-cut diamond set on a shank that is also set with smaller diamonds by Pristine jewelers.

Fans were loving the eye-popping price tags. “Her haters can’t afford the box that watch came in. She worked hard she deserves everything she gets ❤️,” one person commented while another said, “A Libra ALWAYS gets what she wants! 🩷♎️🩷.”

Cardi is no stranger to big purchases.

In February, amid breakup rumors that swirled around her relationship with Stefon Diggs, she bought herself a $500,000 rainbow Audemars Piguet watch.

And in August she showed her followers a selection of new bags, ringing in at a grand total of almost $200,000.

Plus, a few months prior, she boasted about a parade of accessories including the “hardest bag to get” from Matthieu Blazy’s Chanel.

بیشتر پوشش ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. Cardi B کاملاً تولد باربی را دارد. مجری که در 11 اکتبر 34 ساله شد، لوازم جانبی لوکس صورتی روشن را که برای جشن گرفتن به خود هدیه داده است به اشتراک گذاشت. خواننده رپ در اینستاگرام نوشت: «از بلکالیس تا کاردی بی… هدیه ای از من به من!» ماوانی. کاردی از او برای "جستجوی سراسر جهان" برای یافتن این قطعه تشکر کرد - و معلوم شد که او بهای گزافی پرداخته است. جواهرساز مدرکی را منتشر کرد که نشان می‌دهد رپر "Bodak Yellow" 2.8 میلیون دلار در دو قسط برای ساعت به او پرداخت کرده است. کاردی در حالی که روبروی یک پیانوی اکریلیک صورتی نشسته بود، ساعت را همراه با فید خود به اشتراک گذاشت. جواهرساز در حالی که ساعت رولکس باربی دیتونا را از قاب سبزش بیرون می‌آورد، به او گفت: «احتمالاً فقط 10 عدد در دنیا ساخته شده است.» اما هدایا به همین جا ختم نشد. او همچنین یک Hermès Mini Kelly در تمساح مات صورتی آدامسی و یک حلقه الماس سفارشی خریداری کرد. در حالی که قیمت Kelly فاش نشده بود، قبلاً به قیمت 200000 دلار در بازار ثانویه فروخته شده بود. در مورد انگشتر، این یک الماس 7 قیراطی است که با تراش مارکیزی طبیعی روی یک ساق ست شده است که توسط جواهرسازان بکر نیز با الماس های کوچکتر ست شده است. طرفداران قیمت های چشمگیر را دوست داشتند. یک نفر اظهار داشت: "متنفران او نمی توانند جعبه ای که ساعت واردش شده است بپردازند. او سخت کار کرده است، او سزاوار هر چیزی است که به دست می آورد ❤️" در حالی که دیگری گفت: "یک ترازو همیشه به آنچه می خواهد می رسد! 🩷♎️🩷."
کاردی عجیب نیست

Republican state attorney general candidate Saritha Komatireddy on Friday vowed to declare a state of emergency over soaring antisemitism, if elected — following the terrifying syringe stabbing of a young rabbi in the Diamond District this week.

Komatireddy — a former federal prosecutor running against Democratic incumbent Attorney General Letitia James — made the promise while speaking from the site of Wednesday’s attack, where a woman was filmed stalking 26-year-old Yousef Krish before apparently plunging a syringe into his back.

“When I am attorney general, I will declare a state of emergency on antisemitism on day one,” Komatireddy told reporters.

She noted that despite Jewish New Yorkers making up roughly 10-12% of the Big Appel’s population, they have faced more than 50% of all confirmed hate crimes this year, according to NYPD statistics released this month.

“Every Jewish New Yorker is feeling the rise of hate in our city and in our state,” Komatireddy said.

In what could be the most recent incident in the ongoing spate of anti-Jewish hate, Krish was walking along West 47th Street at around 6 p.m. during the evening bustle when a Russian-speaking woman began harassing him, according to police and law enforcement sources.

Video showed him trying to evade her and dodging into the street — but she followed and then jabbed him in the back with something sharp, the sources said. He was taken to a hospital in stable condition after the attack.

“I’m still shaken,” Krish, a Brooklyn resident, told Jewish digital platform Chabad.org. “I never imagined I’d be stabbed simply for being Jewish, right here in New York City.”

Krish, who recently received his rabbinic ordination, makes the trek from Crown Heights to Midtown daily to share religious teachings with Jewish merchants in the area, the outlet reported.

“As I try to make sense of what happened, I keep thinking about my grandparents,” he told Chabad.org. “They survived the Holocaust, experienced the worst of hatred, and still went on to build a proud Jewish family.

“I know what they’d tell me now: Don’t back down.”

Krish’s attacker has yet to be identified or arrested, but the NYPD’s Hate Crime Task Force was investigating.

His father told The Post on Friday Krish was “doing OK” and was under medical supervision to make sure no complications arose from the stabbing, which left his lower back bloody.

“Everyone knows about it,” he said when asked about the rise of antisemitism across the city. “Something needs to be done.”

Jewish New Yorkers have been randomly punched or accosted on city sidewalks in recent months, while an Upper West Side man was stabbed in the chest by a hateful nut screaming “Allahu Akbar!’’ as he left a synagogue in July.

More than half of voting-aged Jews have also reported feeling unsafe in the city — especially since the Oct. 7, 2023 Hamas terror attack on Israel — while 42% have reported being verbally harassed for their faith.

“Even when we have the best police force in the world, and we do, they can arrest someone, but if there’s not follow-up through charging, prosecution, conviction, and sentencing, then it won’t work,” Komatireddy noted.

“The stakes couldn’t be higher. Crime instills fear in communities. Crime intimidates. Crime makes people feel unwelcome.”

The candidate also claimed it was “unacceptable” that the AG’s Hate Crimes Unit was “not staffed” under James, something the top prosecutor’s office denied – saying it was part of its full-staffed Civil Rights Bureau.

“I will staff the Hate Crimes Unit, and I will ensure that we prosecute hate crimes and all crime in New York,” Komatireddy added. “I’ll do it myself if I have to.”

Komatireddy was joined by Rabbi Daniel Schonbuch — who compared the state of antisemitism in the city to “1935 in Germany.”

Republican state comptroller candidate Joseph Hernandez, who was also at the press conference, blamed Mayor Zohran Mamdani and his outspoken anti-Israel sentiments for fanning hatred.

“This has to stop. The mayor needs to stop,” Hernandez said. “If this continues, there’s going to be bloodshed. That bloodshed is going to be the responsibility of the mayor. We have to stop this trajectory as soon as possible.”

Komatireddy and James have been closely polling since their fierce debate earlier in October, with some polls finding the incumbent leading by about 50.7% to 44.7% ahead of the Nov. 3 election.

James, who has been AG since 2019, defended her history of addressing antisemitism in a statement to The Post — accusing Komatireddy of “political theater.”

“New York Attorney General Letitia James has proudly stood shoulder to shoulder with Jewish New Yorkers at every stage of her career — protecting communities from discriminatory scams and restrictive zoning — while our opponent plays politics,” a campaign spokesperson said.

Kris Jenner allegedly “flipped out on camera” after finding out her past affair is included in a new biography about her daughter, Kim Kardashian.

“Citizen Kim: The Woman Who Created the Future” author Jonathan Van Meter, who has extensively spent time with the reality-famous clan, said in a new interview that Kardashian had called him “late at night” a few months ago.

When asked if any of the Kardashian-Jenner family members had read the book — which is slated for release Oct. 27 — the author answered that Kim had “been at Khloé’s house, where Khloé told her Kris had flipped out on camera while they were filming the show,” referencing Kim’s younger sister.

He recounted Kim telling him that Kris was yelling, “Why did Kim drag us all into this? Why is my affair from 30 years ago in the book?”

Van Meter claimed that “two days later,” the matriarch “was fine.”

But, he added, “It’s going to be on the show,” referencing the family’s Hulu series — now in its eighth season, “The Kardashians.”

The author claimed the Skims founder said to Kris, “All this stuff gets written about us, and then a guy comes along who gets us and wants to explain us. Why wouldn’t you want that?”

Van Meter added, “That’s the closest I got to an answer about why she did the book,” referencing the reality star’s participation in the biography.

A rep for Kim and Kris did not immediately respond to Page Six’s request for comment on Friday.

While the biographer doesn’t name names, Kris previously disclosed an extramarital relationship with Todd Waterman back in 1989, during her marriage to Kim’s father, the late Robert Kardashian.

Kris — who was married to the O.J. Simpson defense attorney from 1978 to 1991 and shared kids Kim, Khloe, Kourtney, and Rob Kardashian Jr. with him — has confessed deep regret for the months long relationship.

“I think that I fell into a situation where I thought that the grass was greener somewhere else,” Kris said during a 2023 episode of the series, when asked by Khloé why she cheated on their father.

“And I made a huge mistake,” she continued, adding, “That’s like my life’s biggest regret.”

Robert Sr. died in September 2003 at the age of 59 after a brief battle with esophageal cancer.

Kris, now 70, went on to marry the former Bruce Jenner in 1991 before separating in 2013. Kris and Caitlyn Jenner, who publicly came out as transgender in 2015, welcomed daughters Kendall Jenner, 30, and Kylie Jenner, 29, during their union.

news.originalContent:
Mehdi Hasan debates ex-Trump adviser Steve Cortes on the economy, Trump’s immigration policies and Islamophobia.

With the US midterm elections approaching, the balance of power in Congress is at stake, and the outcome could shape the legacy of President Donald Trump’s second term. As Republicans face growing voter dissatisfaction, Trump’s record has become a central battleground in the fight to control Congress.

Trump faces mounting challenges, including low approval ratings, an unpopular war in Iran, high inflation and petrol prices, economic uncertainty surrounding his tariff policies, and widespread backlash over his immigration crackdown.

How does Trump’s second term measure up against the promises he made on the campaign trail?

In this interview, Mehdi Hasan goes head-to-head with Steve Cortes, a former Trump campaign adviser, who defends the president’s second-term agenda, including his economic and immigration policies, and Islamophobic rhetoric.

Olivia Troye – Former homeland security and counterterrorism adviser to Vice President Mike Pence
Mike Nellis – Democratic strategist and former senior adviser to Vice President Kamala Harris
Rob Arlett – Former Trump campaign chair and political commentator

مهدی حسن با استیو کورتس مشاور سابق ترامپ در مورد اقتصاد، سیاست های مهاجرتی ترامپ و اسلام هراسی مناظره می کند. با نزدیک شدن به انتخابات میان دوره ای ایالات متحده، موازنه قوا در کنگره در خطر است و نتیجه می تواند میراث دور دوم ریاست جمهوری دونالد ترامپ را شکل دهد. از آنجایی که جمهوری خواهان با نارضایتی فزاینده رأی دهندگان مواجه هستند، سابقه ترامپ به میدان اصلی مبارزه برای کنترل کنگره تبدیل شده است. ترامپ با چالش‌های فزاینده‌ای از جمله محبوبیت پایین، جنگ غیرمحبوب در ایران، تورم بالا و قیمت بنزین، عدم اطمینان اقتصادی پیرامون سیاست‌های تعرفه‌ای او، و واکنش‌های گسترده نسبت به سرکوب مهاجرت‌اش مواجه است. دور دوم ترامپ با وعده‌هایی که در مبارزات انتخاباتی داده بود چگونه مقایسه می‌شود؟ در این مصاحبه، مهدی حسن با استیو کورتس، مشاور سابق ستاد انتخاباتی ترامپ، که از دستور کار دوره دوم رئیس جمهور، از جمله سیاست های اقتصادی و مهاجرتی، و لفاظی های اسلام هراسانه او دفاع می کند، رودررو می شود.

news.originalContent:
Rebel commander pledged to continue fighting government-allied forces who seized Ethiopia’s Tigray capital.

Residents recount drone strikes in Ethiopia’s northern Tigray region

An official in Tigray’s new federally backed administration has urged rebel forces to lay down their weapons in the northern Ethiopian region.

The call on Friday came hours after a rebel commander told his fighters to continue resisting government-backed forces despite losing control of Mekelle, the Tigray region’s capital.

Fighters from the Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF) were forced to withdraw from Mekelle in early October, after government-allied fighters entered the city to crush a rebel attempt to overthrow Ethiopia’s government.

Ethiopia’s government then installed a six-month caretaker administration in Tigray, promising to restore services, help displaced people return and prepare for elections.

But some fighting has continued, with Mekelle residents reporting a drone strike that killed four people and injured six others as they loaded goats onto a truck on Tuesday. The casualties could not be independently verified.

Redae Halefom Woldeselassie, a senior official in Tigray’s new caretaker administration, said rebel forces were collapsing and urged fighters to lay down their weapons.

“This is not the time for settling scores – I call upon you to return to your homes and continue your civilian lives,” he said in Mekelle.

He dismissed the prospect of the rebels retaking the city, maintaining the conflict served a small clique of leaders and not the people of Tigray.

Hours earlier, Lieutenant General Fisseha Kidanu, who was identified in a television broadcast as commander of the Tigray army, pledged to reverse recent military setbacks, saying Tigray was still at war.

“Local militias across the region – alongside all volunteers joining the resistance – are expected to engage the enemy,” he said Thursday on Tigray Broadcast Media, a new rebel television station. His location was not disclosed.

Fisseha urged attacks on government-held positions despite his opponents’ advantages in drones and heavy weapons. The TPLF has also claimed to have inflicted heavy losses on government forces. The Associated Press could not independently verify those claims.

The government’s allies include the Tigray Peace Force, comprising former members of the TPLF’s armed wing – a division within Tigrayan forces that has complicated the renewed conflict.

Redae said Ethiopian troops and allied forces were conducting joint security operations, including measures to prevent looting. He promised preparations for displaced residents to return but gave no timetable.

Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed, speaking Monday to the Ethiopian Broadcasting Corporation, accused the TPLF of forcibly recruiting young people to fight instead of disarming under the terms of the November 2022 Pretoria peace agreement.

The renewed fighting has effectively shattered the agreement, which ended the region’s devastating 2020-2022 war.

That conflict caused an estimated 500,000 civilian deaths through violence, famine and collapsed health services, according to researchers at Ghent University in Belgium.
news.content:
فرمانده شورشیان متعهد شد که به مبارزه با نیروهای متحد دولت که پایتخت تیگری اتیوپی را تصرف کردند، ادامه دهد. ساکنان حملات هواپیماهای بدون سرنشین در منطقه تیگری شمالی اتیوپی را بازگو می کنند.
یک مقام در دولت جدید تیگری که از حمایت فدرال برخوردار است از نیروهای شورشی خواسته است که سلاح های خود را در منطقه شمالی اتیوپی زمین بگذارند. این تماس در روز جمعه ساعاتی پس از آن صورت گرفت که یک فرمانده شورشیان به جنگجویانش گفت که علیرغم از دست دادن کنترل مکله، پایتخت منطقه تیگری، به مقاومت در برابر نیروهای تحت حمایت دولت ادامه دهند. جنگجویان جبهه آزادیبخش خلق تیگری (TPLF) در اوایل اکتبر مجبور به عقب نشینی از مکله شدند، پس از اینکه جنگجویان متحد دولت برای سرکوب تلاش شورشیان دولت برای سرکوبی شورشیان به شهر وارد شدند. دولت اتیوپی سپس یک اداره موقت شش ماهه را در تیگری نصب کرد و قول داد خدمات را بازگرداند، به آوارگان کمک کند تا برگردند و برای انتخابات آماده شوند. اما برخی درگیری ها ادامه یافته است و ساکنان مکله از حمله هواپیمای بدون سرنشین گزارش دادند که در روز سه شنبه در حالی که بزها را در کامیون سوار کردند، چهار نفر کشته و شش نفر دیگر زخمی شدند. تلفات را نمی توان به طور مستقل تأیید کرد. Redae Halefom Woldeselassie، یکی از مقامات ارشد در دولت موقت جدید Tigray، گفت که نیروهای شورشی در حال فروپاشی هستند و از جنگجویان خواست سلاح های خود را زمین بگذارند. او در Mekelle گفت: "اکنون زمان تسویه حساب نیست - من از شما می خواهم که به خانه های خود بازگردید و به زندگی غیرنظامی خود ادامه دهید."

news.originalContent:
Luisa Gonzalez, who lost to right-wing president Daniel Noboa in 2023, has called the arrest political persecution.

A judge in Ecuador has ordered that former left-wing presidential candidate Luisa Gonzalez remain detained following her arrest for alleged money laundering.

The order on Friday came the day after 48-year-old Gonzalez, who challenged right-wing President Daniel Noboa in the 2023 election, was arrested in the rural town of Canuto.

Gonzalez, her party and her close ally, former President Rafael Correa, have called the arrest political persecution.

Several other members of Gonzalez’s Citizen Revolution (RC) party have also recently faced charges.

They include Guayaquil Mayor Aquiles Alvarez, convicted of illegally selling subsidised fuel and former Vice President Jorge Glas, serving a sentence for corruption.

Prosecutors have said that Gonzalez is one of seven people under investigation for financing the 2023 presidential campaign. The probe focuses on $500,000 poured into advertising during the race.

Gonzalez has denied wrongdoing, dismissing the charges as “absurd”.

Citizen Revolution President Gabriela Rivadeneira told a news conference on Thursday that Gonzalez’s arrest “confirms or makes visible what we have been saying lately: Ecuador is living under a dictatorship”.

Gonzalez, a lawyer and former member of Ecuador’s National Assembly, lost to Noboa in an April 2025 run-off. She rejected the result as fraudulent.

Noboa, a close ally of US President Donald Trump, later accused Citizen Revolution of conspiring to attack him.

The party has since been banned from running in local elections next month.
news.content: لوئیزا گونزالس که در سال 2023 از رئیس جمهور راستگرای دانیل نوبوآ شکست خورد، دستگیری را آزار و شکنجه سیاسی خواند. یک قاضی در اکوادور دستور داد که لوئیزا گونزالس، نامزد چپ‌گرای سابق ریاست جمهوری، پس از دستگیری وی به اتهام پولشویی، در بازداشت بماند. انتخابات 2023، در شهر روستایی کانوتو دستگیر شد. گونزالس، حزب او و متحد نزدیکش، رئیس جمهور سابق، رافائل کورئا، این دستگیری را آزار و اذیت سیاسی خوانده اند. چند تن دیگر از اعضای حزب انقلاب شهروندی گونزالس (RC) نیز اخیرا با اتهاماتی روبرو شده اند. از جمله آنها می توان به آکوئیلس آلوارز، شهردار گوایاکیل، که به فروش غیرقانونی سوخت یارانه ای برای جورج معاون رئیس جمهور فاسد محکوم شد، و جورج معاون رئیس جمهور سابق محکوم شد. دادستان ها گفته اند که گونزالس یکی از هفت نفری است که به دلیل تامین مالی کمپین ریاست جمهوری 2023 تحت بازجویی قرار گرفته است. این تحقیقات روی 500000 دلاری که در طول مسابقه برای تبلیغات ریخته شده است، متمرکز است. گونزالس تخلفات را رد کرده و اتهامات را "بیهوده" رد کرده است. گابریلا ریوادنیرا، رئیس جمهوری شهروندی، روز پنجشنبه در یک کنفرانس مطبوعاتی گفت که دستگیری گونزالس «آنچه را که اخیراً گفته‌ایم تأیید یا قابل مشاهده است: اکوادور تحت دیکتاتوری زندگی می‌کند». او نتیجه را به عنوان تقلبی رد کرد. نوبوآ، متحد نزدیک رئیس جمهور ایالات متحده، D

news.originalContent:
Man City are the only team with a perfect Premier League record, but face a Villa side determined to climb the table.

Who: Aston Villa vs Manchester City
What: English Premier League
Where: Villa Park in Birmingham, United Kingdom
When: Saturday, October 22 at 12:30pm (11:30 GMT)
How to follow: Al Jazeera will bring you all the build-up, before our live text commentary stream from 9:30am (08:30 GMT).

Manchester City can continue to put their off-field woes to one side in Saturday’s early kickoff in the Premier League when they travel to Aston Villa, where they will move six points clear at the top with a win.

Holders Arsenal entertain Everton later in the day and will very much hope to extend their winning run in the league to a third match.

City do, however, have a 100 percent record from their first seven games in the league this season, a run that defies the guilty verdict by an independent commission regarding more than 100 breaches of the competition’s financial rules.

The Manchester club have appealed the decision and no sanctions have, as of yet, been imposed.

Al Jazeera Sport takes a look at City’s trip to Villa Park, where the Cityzens ’ siege mentality is expected to continue.

Enzo Maresca said it is his job as Manchester City boss to help Phil Foden rediscover his best form after the England international ended his long goal drought.

Foden had not scored for 10 months before netting in City’s 3-2 win over Ipswich last weekend and then scored a Champions League hat-trick in a 5-1 rout of AEK Athens on Tuesday.

The 26-year-old swept the board of personal awards for the Premier League’s best player in the 2023/24 season after a 27-goal campaign.

But Foden, who has admitted struggling with mental health issues, has failed to hit top form for the past two seasons.

“Since we started, I sat down with Phil two or three times, especially at the beginning. Just to show him, I don’t know if love is the right word to use, but just to show him how important he is,” said Maresca, who took charge of City in June.

“I said many times that I know Phil from years ago, so I know how, for different reasons, the last few years it was not good enough.

“When you have more players like Phil available, you are a better team because again it’s a matter of improving players. If you improve the players, you improve the team.

“So for me, I think it’s my duty to try to help Phil to be again one of the best players in England.”

Other than a 4-2 Champions League defeat by holders Paris Saint-Germain, Maresca has made a flawless start to the daunting task of succeeding Pep Guardiola at the Etihad Stadium.

The Italian is the first manager ever to win his first seven Premier League games in charge of a new club.

However, City’s fine form has been overshadowed by the threat of severe sanctions against the club for the widespread flouting of Premier League financial rules.

A large points deduction, which could lead to relegation, is likely unless City win their appeal.

Maresca said the mood in the dressing room remained buoyant despite the cloud hanging over the club.

“In any club, when you lose important players, many important players, and you lose the manager after 10 years, it always takes time to compete again,” he said on Thursday.

“But this organisation last summer changed many important players, changed the manager after 10 years, and we are competing at the moment.”

Villa sit 12th in the table, but a win would propel them to sixth, at least for a couple of hours. Under former Arsenal manager Unai Emery, Villa have been regulars among the European spots in recent seasons, and were even challengers for the title at one point.

This term has provided a sterner examination of their credentials after the exit of a number of the top stars of recent campaigns, including Morgan Rogers and Emiliano Martinez to Chelsea, Youri Tielemans to City’s rivals United and Ollie Watkins to Al-Hilal.

The Midlands club, who beat Freiburg 3-0 to win last season’s UEFA Europa League, are on a six-match unbeaten run – of which they have won five – across the league and Champions League.

Villa were 2-1 winners at City in Pep Guardiola’s last game in charge on the final day of last season.

Antoine Semenyo gave City the lead, but an Ollie Watkins brace turned the game.

Villa emerged with a 1-0 win in their Premier League clash at Villa Park last October. Matty Cash scored the only goal.

City last beat Villa when they were 2-1 winners in the Premier League fixture between the sides at Etihad Stadium in April 2025.

Marcus Rashford, on loan from United, levelled matters from the penalty spot after Bernardo Silva’s opener, but Matheus Nunes sealed the win for the home side.

City have not won at Villa Park since December 2021, when Ruben Diaz and Silva netted in the first half of the Premier League match. Watkins’s strike in the second period proved only a consolation.

The Opta supercomputer has given City a 43 percent chance of winning the match, while offering Villa a 32 percent chance of victory.

This is the 186th meeting between the sides, with City winning 82 times and Villa emerging victorious on 61 occasions. There have been 42 draws in the fixture that dates back to 1899 – and a 2-1 home win for Villa.

Amadou Onana, Matteo Ruggeri and Aaron Wan-Bissaka miss out through injury. Johan Manzambi and Modou Keba Cisse both face fitness tests.

Suzuki; Cash, Lindelof, Torres, Maatsen; Kamara, Gomes; McGinn, Manzambi, Buendia; Jackson

Forward Antoine Semenyo is set for a lengthy spell out ⁠with a knee injury, while wing back Nico O’Reilly and midfielders Mateo Kovacic and Matheus Nunes are doubts.

League-leading scorer Erling Haaland was rested for Tuesday’s 5-1 Champions League thrashing of AEK Athens because of a knock but is expected to be available against Villa.

news.originalContent:
Photo by Spencer Platt/Getty Images)

The unholy alliance between the gambling industry and news organizations is growing deeper.

As part of a new sponsorship agreement with the gambling giant DraftKings, local news stations owned by CBS News must air four DraftKings “hits” per day between Oct. 26 and Nov. 3, according to an exclusive report from Status. The deal frustrated some executives, who believed the optics of mixing gambling and news coverage could undermine faith in elections, Status reported. (RELATED: CNN Just Cracked Open Pandora’s Box That’s Worse Than Any Fake News Hoax)

CBS News is not the first media organization to partner with the gambling industry.

In late 2025, CNN announced a partnership with the prediction market company Kalshi. A day later, CNBC announced a similar deal.

“CNBC will incorporate exclusive Kalshi predictions market data into its programs, including ‘Squawk Box’ and ‘Fast Money,’ offering viewers a unique perspective on how event forecasts and probabilities are shifting in real time. A Kalshi ticker will run alongside segments of CNBC’s on-air programming. Kalshi will also launch a CNBC page on its site, featuring CNBC-selected markets,” the network said.

The Associated Press also partnered with Kalshi in March.

“The Associated Press for nearly two centuries has played an essential role in American democracy as the most authoritative source for accurate results on election night,” David Scott, vice president for AP Elections, said. “We’re pleased to be working with Kalshi as we work to expand the reach of AP’s trusted elections data, meeting audiences where they are with reliable information about who voters have chosen to lead their country and communities.” (RELATED: Special Forces Soldier Accused Of Gambling On Maduro Raid Pleads Not Guilty)

Meanwhile, The Wall Street Journal has struck a deal with Kalshi’s competitor, Polymarket.

“We’re making prediction markets data accessible to our users, because it’s a rapidly growing source of real-time insight into collective beliefs about future events,” Almar Latour, CEO of Dow Jones and publisher of The Wall Street Journal, said. “Our mission is to help people make decisions by offering them reliable news, data and analysis. In partnering with Polymarket, we aim to help consumers better interpret market sentiment and assess risk alongside traditional financial indicators.”

Critics argue that because prediction markets allow traders to wager on something as simple as whether a CNN host will say a particular word during a broadcast, the partnership opens up a Pandora’s box of ethical concerns. Reporters and broadcasters, for example, could cover a breaking news event in a way that benefits a wager they made on one of the partnering platforms.

A CBS News spokesman told Status that the sponsorship deal is strictly commercial and will have no effect on its editorial decisions or election coverage.
news.content:
عکس توسط اسپنسر پلات/گتی ایماژ)
اتحاد نامقدس بین صنعت قمار و سازمان‌های خبری عمیق‌تر می‌شود. بر اساس گزارشی اختصاصی از Status، به عنوان بخشی از یک قرارداد حمایت مالی جدید با غول قمار DraftKings، ایستگاه‌های خبری محلی متعلق به CBS News باید روزانه چهار "هیت" DraftKings را بین 26 اکتبر و 3 نوامبر پخش کنند. استاتوس گزارش داد که این معامله برخی از مدیران را ناامید کرد، آنها معتقد بودند که ترکیب قمار و پوشش خبری می تواند ایمان به انتخابات را تضعیف کند. (مرتبط: CNN همین الان جعبه پاندورا را باز کرد که بدتر از هر جعلی اخبار جعلی است)
CBS News اولین سازمان رسانه ای نیست که با صنعت قمار شریک می شود. در اواخر سال 2025، CNN اعلام کرد که با شرکت بازار پیش بینی Kalshi همکاری می کند. یک روز بعد، CNBC معامله مشابهی را اعلام کرد. CNBC داده‌های انحصاری بازار پیش‌بینی‌های Kalshi را در برنامه‌های خود گنجانده است، از جمله «Squawk Box» و «Fast Money»، به بینندگان چشم‌اندازی منحصربه‌فرد در مورد نحوه تغییر پیش‌بینی رویدادها و احتمالات در زمان واقعی ارائه می‌کند. یک علامت Kalshi در کنار بخش‌هایی از CNBC روی آنتن اجرا می‌شود. news.originalContent:
Lawyers for two accused officials say Department of Justice seeking to revive scandal before midterm vote.

Two former Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) agents have been charged in connection with a 2020 probe into a laptop belonging to former President Joe Biden’s son, Hunter Biden.

The former officials, Nikki Floris and Bradley Benavides, were charged with lying to Congress. They made their first court appearance in Washington, DC, on Friday.

Lawyers for the officials accused the Department of Justice of filing the charges to revive the salacious saga just days before the November 3 midterm vote, in which Republicans face an uphill battle against Democrats to maintain control of Congress.

A lawyer for Floris said she “served our nation as a dedicated FBI intelligence officer for nearly 20 years”, while accusing the Justice Department of building its case on hearsay.

“Yet today, the DOJ [Justice Department] has accused her falsely of a crime on the say-so of politicians, not on the facts,” the statement said.

“It’s no coincidence the government is filing these nonsense charges now, years later, on the eve of an election.”

Floris and Benavides had overseen the Foreign Intelligence Task Force (FITF) at the FBI when Hunter Biden’s laptop was found. The pair testified to Congress that the unit, which focuses on foreign interference in US elections, was not involved in the laptop investigation.

In a criminal complaint, federal prosecutors alleged the statements contradicted messages sent during the same period.

While launched by Trump during his first term, the FITF was heavily targeted by Republicans under former US President Joe Biden. They charged the unit was politically biased and used to cover up information about Biden’s laptop.

The unit was disbanded when Trump took office for the second time in January 2025.

The existence of the laptop became known in October of 2020, just weeks before Biden and Trump faced off in a presidential election.

Its strange origins, having been dropped off at a Delaware computer repair shop and apparently abandoned by Hunter Biden, prompted suspicion. Its contents were first reported on by the New York Post, based on information provided to Trump lawyer Rudy Giuliani.

Several former intelligence officials warned that the laptop had the hallmarks of a Russian disinformation campaign. However, the FBI later seized and verified that the laptop and its contents, including messages related to the younger Biden’s foreign business ties and explicit photos of his drug use, were authentic.

The laptop was later used to back federal gun and tax evasion charges against Hunter Biden, although no wrongdoing related to his business ties or connection with his father was found.

Trump FBI Director Kash Patel has pledged to investigate the agency’s conduct throughout Biden’s presidency. Critics have accused him of flagrant politicalisation.

“Lying to Congress by senior FBI officials strikes at the heart of our system. No one is above the law,” Patel said in a statement posted on X.

The Justice Department has historically sought to avoid public and overt investigative acts in the direct lead-up to an election that involve candidates or that risk influencing an outcome.

But officials in the last two weeks have made a series of bold moves in cases with political undertones, including a search of Democratic Representative Ilhan Omar’s house in an immigration fraud investigation.

The department also unsealed a corruption indictment on Thursday against powerful Democratic Virginia state Senator L Louise Lucas.
news.content:
وکلای دو مقام متهم می گویند که وزارت دادگستری به دنبال احیای رسوایی قبل از رای گیری میان دوره ای است. دو مامور سابق اداره تحقیقات فدرال (اف بی آی) در ارتباط با تحقیقات سال 2020 در رابطه با لپ تاپ متعلق به هانتر بایدن، پسر جو بایدن، پسر رئیس جمهور سابق جو بایدن متهم شده اند. مقامات سابق، نیکی فلوریس، و بردلی بینویدس به کنگره متهم شدند. آنها روز جمعه برای اولین بار در دادگاه در واشنگتن دی سی حاضر شدند. وکلای این مقامات وزارت دادگستری را متهم کردند که برای احیای این حماسه شوم فقط چند روز قبل از رای گیری میان دوره ای در 3 نوامبر، که در آن جمهوری خواهان برای حفظ کنترل کنگره با نبرد سختی علیه دموکرات ها روبرو هستند، اتهاماتی را مطرح کرده است. یک وکیل فلوریس گفت که او "نزدیک به 20 سال به عنوان یک افسر اطلاعاتی فداکار FBI به کشور ما خدمت کرده است" در حالی که وزارت دادگستری را متهم کرده است. در بیانیه آمده است: «اما امروز، وزارت دادگستری [وزارت دادگستری] او را به دروغ به گفته سیاستمداران به جنایت متهم کرده است، نه بر اساس واقعیت.» تصادفی نیست که دولت این اتهامات مزخرف را اکنون، سال ها بعد، در آستانه انتخابات مطرح می کند.
فلوریس و بناویدز هنگام پیدا شدن لپ‌تاپ هانتر بایدن بر گروه ویژه اطلاعات خارجی (FITF) در FBI نظارت داشتند. این زوج به کنگره شهادت دادند که این واحد که بر مداخله خارجی در انتخابات ایالات متحده متمرکز است، در تحقیقات لپ‌تاپ دخالتی نداشت.

news.originalContent:
The Justice Department lawsuit raises concerns the administration may be looking to meddle in some of this midterm cycle’s races.

With just more than a week until the pivotal US midterm elections, the US Department of Justice has filed a lawsuit to block certification of the results in Alaska’s hotly contested Senate race.

In a lawsuit filed on Thursday, the Justice Department argued that an independent candidate with the same name as the state’s incumbent Republican Senator Dan Sullivan, who is currently running for re-election, is purposefully running to mislead voters.

“Given the substantial likelihood that the inclusion of Daniel J Sullivan will confuse or mislead voters looking to cast a vote for Senator Sullivan, and thus distort the will of Alaskan voters, there is a substantial likelihood that a certification of the election will reflect an electoral process that lacked integrity,” the Trump administration’s filing read.

The Justice Department is asking a federal judge to delay certification to allow time for an investigation into “whether votes cast for Daniel J Sullivan were meant to be cast for Senator Sullivan”.

During a visit to Florida on Friday, Trump took credit for the lawsuit after reporters asked about it.

“I’m the one that said ‘do it,'” he told reporters in Fort Myers, Florida.

A Justice Department spokesperson did not respond to Al Jazeera’s request for comment.

The lawsuit raises concerns among Democrats and voting rights groups that the Trump administration may be looking to meddle in some of the upcoming midterm races as Republicans across the United States struggle to push back a growing wave of Democratic support.

The Justice Department, as of late, has taken several actions against Democratic critics of President Donald Trump that have bolstered those worries, including charging a high-ranking Virginia lawmaker, state Senator L Louise Lucas, in a public corruption case and launching a probe into Democratic Representative Ilhan Omar over allegations of immigration fraud. Both have said the actions are politically motivated.

Trump critics have long expressed worries that the Justice Department could seek to block certification of elections the US president’s party loses.

On Wednesday, as Lucas’s indictment was announced, US Attorney General Todd Blanche told reporters his agency would not do so unless extreme circumstances warranted such action.

“It is not DOJ’s intention to – and it’s never our intention to – improperly interfere with elections or the state certification process,” Blanche said.

The Brennan Center for Justice’s senior counsel, Lauren Miller Karalunas, said in a statement that election certification is handled by US states and the federal government has “no role” in it.

“Rest assured, state certification processes were created to meet this moment,” Karalunas said. “Centuries ago, state legislatures recognized that bad actors could use the process to manipulate election outcomes. They built in safeguards specifically designed to stop that from happening.”

The Alaska state Supreme Court in June rejected a previous Republican effort to remove Daniel J Sullivan from the ballot. He will appear without a party designation by his name, while Senator Sullivan will be listed as the Republican candidate.

However, under Alaska’s ranked-choice voting system, voters can select both Sullivans if they are unsure.

Which party controls the US Senate after November 3 could, ultimately, come down to Alaska’s Senate race, where Senator Sullivan is engaged in a challenging re-election fight against former US Democratic Congresswoman Mary Peltola.

Polling of the race has consistently shown a race that is well within the margin of error. A survey conducted by Public Policy Polling earlier this month suggested Peltola had a narrow one-point lead.

The campaign teams for both Sullivans and Peltola did not immediately return requests for comment.

news.originalContent:
(Photo by Drew Angerer/Getty Images)

A Vanity Fair excerpt from an upcoming book alleges that Russian military intelligence hacked former Trump White House senior adviser Jared Kushner’s phone, exposing purported access to Middle Eastern bank accounts holding at least $2 billion.

The article, published Thursday, was an exclusive excerpt from a book written by Matthew Cole entitled “Princes and Thieves: Jared Kushner and Mohamed bin Zayed’s Secret Plot to Remake the Middle East.” (RELATED: The Deep State Is Leaking Trump’s Most Sensitive Undercover Operations To The Washington Post)

The excerpt said that sometime between 2017 and 2018, Russian military intelligence was able to hack Kushner’s phone.

After Dutch intelligence arranged for British authorities to apprehend a Russian military intelligence operative and offered him the choice of cooperating against the Russians or facing arrest, the operative gave the Dutch access to a Russian intelligence server containing screenshots of Kushner’s iPhone. Dutch intelligence later developed its own method of monitoring Kushner’s screen as he used his phone.

(L-R) Senior Advisor Jared Kushner looks on as U.S. President Donald Trump speaks before signing the United States-Mexico-Canada Trade Agreement (USMCA) during a ceremony on the South Lawn of the White House on January 29, 2020 in Washington, DC. (Photo by Drew Angerer/Getty Images)

Cole alleged that Kushner had access to “Alpha” and “Beta” bank accounts connected to leaders of the United Arab Emirates (UAE) and Saudi Arabia.

The Alpha account was allegedly held at the UAE’s largest bank and overseen by the bank’s chairman, the brother of Mohamed bin Zayed (MBZ), the president of the UAE.

The author wrote that $750 million was transferred into the Alpha account, which Kushner and MBZ would oversee and partially manage as part of an effort to strike a deal to end the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.

“Jared was looking for shortcuts in his diplomacy,” a source who had spoken with both UAE and Israeli officials about the account reportedly told Cole, adding that this style was typical of Emirati and Saudi leaders. “Jared promised MBZ that he’d push their agenda with Trump if they participated in a fund. He wanted normalization with Israel so that business could take off.”

Dutch intelligence traced the funds to an Azerbaijani government-linked bank account that sent hundreds of millions of dollars to a Dubai account, according to Cole.

“Regardless of whether he was a signatory or the owner, Jared was required by federal government regulations and the Internal Revenue Service to disclose his access to the account,” Cole wrote. “Unless disclosed to and approved by the US government and reported on his tax returns, Kushner’s access to the Alpha account may have violated US law.”

Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, President of the United Arab Emirates, is greeted by German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier at Villa Borsig on September 10, 2026 in Berlin, Germany. (Photo by Omer Messinger/Getty Images)

By spring 2018, the Beta account had moved about $1 billion to Israel through Azerbaijan for Kushner, Cole wrote, alleging that someone who knew about the money told him it was for Kushner’s personal benefit.

One source reportedly told Cole that the money had been transferred in “significant amounts” to individuals including a warlord, a mercenary and a former hit man.

Kushner rejected these accusations, calling Cole’s claims “completely insane, categorically false, and never happened.”

Kushner said he has denied each claim and said the author has failed to present any substantial evidence, including bank statements, wire transfer records, account numbers, transaction dates, or other verifiable details.

Kushner added he was “one of the most scrutinized people in the world” during the time of the alleged accounts, noting that despite media coverage, congressional investigations and a special counsel investigation, none of these allegations have ever surfaced.

“These are outrageous fabrications being presented as investigative journalism,” Kushner said. “This is not journalism. It is a mixture of fantasy, fiction, and advocacy, written by someone who is either deeply disturbed or acting with sinister intent.”

.@VanityFair posted an excerpt from a book containing outrageous and categorically false allegations. The allegations made by this author are completely insane and never happened. We denied every one of these claims on the record, yet the author failed to provide a single shred of evidence to substantiate any of them. No bank statements, wire transfer records, account numbers, transaction dates, or other verifiable details were provided to support these extraordinary accusations. During the period in question, I was one of the most scrutinized people in the world, subjected to intense media coverage, multiple congressional investigations, and a special counsel investigation. I voluntarily cooperated with these investigations, providing over 30 hours of testimony. None of these allegations ever surfaced, because none of these events ever happened. These are outrageous fabrications being presented as investigative journalism. This is not journalism. It is a mixture of fantasy, fiction, and advocacy, written by someone who is either deeply disturbed or acting with sinister intent.

Kushner’s legal counsel, Chad Mizelle, took it further, saying that they intend to pursue legal action against groups publishing such “categorically false and defamatory allegations.”

In an official statement, Mizelle said the book’s central allegation is false, as “there are no bank accounts.”

Mizelle continued, saying no evidence has been produced that his client’s phone was ever hacked, and noted that the Jerusalem Post took down its reporting on Cole’s claims after identifying “significant factual questions about the alleged financial transactions.”

(عکس از درو آنگرر/گتی ایماژ)
گزیده‌ای از Vanity Fair از یک کتاب آینده ادعا می‌کند که اطلاعات نظامی روسیه تلفن جارد کوشنر، مشاور ارشد سابق ترامپ در کاخ سفید را هک کرده و دسترسی ظاهراً به حساب‌های بانکی خاورمیانه با حداقل ۲ میلیارد دلار را فاش کرده است. این مقاله که پنجشنبه منتشر شد، گزیده ای اختصاصی از کتابی بود که متیو کول با عنوان «شاهزاده ها و دزدان: جرد کوشنر و نقشه مخفی محمد بن زاید برای بازسازی خاورمیانه» نوشته بود. (مرتبط: دولت عمیق در حال افشای حساس ترین عملیات مخفی ترامپ به واشنگتن پست است)
در این گزیده آمده است که بین سال‌های 2017 تا 2018، اطلاعات نظامی روسیه توانسته تلفن کوشنر را هک کند. پس از اینکه سازمان اطلاعات هلند ترتیبی داد تا مقامات انگلیسی یک عامل اطلاعات نظامی روسیه را دستگیر کنند و به او پیشنهاد همکاری علیه روس‌ها یا مواجهه با دستگیری را دادند، این عامل به هلندی اجازه دسترسی به سرور اطلاعات روسیه حاوی تصاویری از آیفون کوشنر را داد. اطلاعات هلندی بعداً روش خود را برای نظارت بر صفحه نمایش کوشنر در هنگام استفاده از تلفن خود توسعه داد. (L-R) جارد کوشنر، مشاور ارشد، دونالد ترامپ، رئیس جمهور ایالات متحده، قبل از امضای توافقنامه تجاری ایالات متحده-مکزیک-کانادا (USMCA) در طی مراسمی در چمن جنوبی کاخ سفید در 29 ژانویه 2020 در واشنگتن دی سی صحبت می کند. (عکس از درو آنگرر/گتی ایماژ)

U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) arrested a violent illegal alien who re-entered the country after being deported twice.

ICE apprehended Serferino Trinidad Ortega, a criminal illegal alien from Mexico, during a targeted enforcement operation, according to documents obtained by the Daily Caller. (RELATED: Trump Zeroes In On Immigration As Midterms Near)

Ortega’s criminal history includes convictions for two counts of cruelty toward his wife, two counts of driving under the influence of liquor, battery, assaulting a police officer, and obstructing a police officer.

When asked about Ortega’s arrest, ICE Assistant Director for Public Affairs Micah Bock told The Caller, “Any illegal alien ICE finds will be deported. ICE is prioritizing Americans’ safety, and that starts with removing these violent criminals from our communities.”

Serferino Trinidad Ortega first illegally entered the United States in 2002 and was ordered to leave the country by an immigration judge.

He was deported in October of that year but later re-entered the country at an unknown date and location. Ortega was deported a second time in August 2014 before illegally entering the U.S. for a third time.

During the targeted enforcement operation on Oct. 18, officers attempted to arrest Ortega, but he allegedly refused to comply with several lawful commands. He then attempted to evade arrest by barricading himself underneath his vehicle, according to the documents.

🚨Trump Zeroes In On Immigration As Midterms Near Trump is heading to his rally in Pendleton, South Carolina, tonight, where he is expected to tout what his administration calls historic border security gains. With the midterms approaching, Trump and the GOP are doubling down on immigration enforcement and deportations during the administration’s October campaign blitz Read more👇@DailyCaller

After officers were finally able to detain him, they determined that Ortega was an illegal immigrant with no legal status allowing him to remain in the United States.

Ortega complained of head pain following the arrest and was transported to a hospital for further evaluation. (RELATED: DOJ Investigating Corey Lewandowski Over Alleged Profiteering At DHS)

After being medically cleared by hospital staff, Ortega was transferred to ICE custody, where he remains pending reinstatement of his prior removal order to Mexico, the Caller has learned.

news.originalContent:
Photo by SAUL LOEB / AFP via Getty Images

Major U.S. banks moved to restrict third-party artificial intelligence agents from accessing customer accounts Thursday amid growing concerns over the security risks posed by automated financial tools.

Citi and Wells Fargo confirmed restrictions to the Daily Caller News Foundation, citing concerns about unauthorized access to customer accounts. The policies highlight a growing challenge for financial institutions as consumers turn to AI tools capable of accessing sensitive banking information and potentially conducting transactions on their behalf. (RELATED: Political Debanking Ran Rampant At America’s Biggest Banks, Federal Probe Alleges)

“To help safeguard customer accounts and information, we do not permit third-party AI agents or assistants to log into a customer’s account or transact directly within our digital banking platforms,” Citi spokeswoman Gabrielle Baum told the DCNF.

“Customers can, however, continue to authorize limited, read-only access to their account information with certain Citi-approved open banking providers,” Baum added.

Wells Fargo also confirmed it has taken steps to restrict unauthorized access.

“Wells Fargo has taken steps to block unauthorized agents from accessing customer accounts,” a company spokesperson told the DCNF.

You have to be retarded to give AI direct access to your bank accounts. The fact that this technology was invented 10 seconds ago and already so many people are willing to just hand their entire lives over to it and make themselves completely dependent on it and vulnerable to it is so unbelievably depressing but also not shocking.

Major financial institutions, including JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, Morgan Stanley and Wells Fargo, are confronting security concerns involving outside AI agents accessing customer accounts, according to an Axios report Thursday. Some agents reportedly appeared to take actions beyond customers’ instructions, according to people familiar with the issue cited in the report.

However, an industry source familiar with the issue told the DCNF that the immediate concern is not AI agents independently infiltrating customer accounts, but customers voluntarily sharing their banking credentials with third-party AI tools.

The source said there is not yet evidence of agents being instructed to perform one task and independently carrying out another. Rather, the activity originates with customers granting access to their accounts, creating potential security risks that banks may struggle to distinguish from legitimate customer activity.

Although customers may authorize AI tools to access their accounts, financial institutions can still prohibit those tools from logging in or conducting transactions.

Unlike conventional chatbots, AI agents are designed to carry out tasks on behalf of users, potentially including reviewing financial information, making purchases or transferring money. Depending on the permissions granted, the technology could move beyond providing financial recommendations to taking actions involving customers’ funds.

Morgan Stanley has begun blocking outside AI agents from accessing its platforms, while JPMorgan, Bank of America and Citi have also restricted access, according to Axios. Banks have tightened restrictions partly over concerns that outside agents could expose customer information or initiate transactions without sufficient safeguards.

AI agents capable of comparing interest rates and moving deposits could eventually challenge traditional banking relationships by making it easier for customers to shift funds between institutions. Such technology could pressure banks’ profitability by helping customers move money out of low-interest accounts, the Financial Times reported in October.
news.content:
عکس توسط SAUL LOEB / AFP از طریق Getty Images
بانک‌های بزرگ ایالات متحده روز پنجشنبه در بحبوحه نگرانی‌های فزاینده در مورد خطرات امنیتی ناشی از ابزارهای مالی خودکار، دسترسی عوامل هوش مصنوعی شخص ثالث به حساب‌های مشتریان را محدود کردند. سیتی و ولز فارگو با اشاره به نگرانی‌ها در مورد دسترسی غیرمجاز به حساب‌های مشتریان، محدودیت‌هایی را برای پایگاه خبری Daily Caller تأیید کردند. این سیاست ها چالش رو به رشدی را برای مؤسسات مالی نشان می دهد زیرا مصرف کنندگان به ابزارهای هوش مصنوعی روی می آورند که قادر به دسترسی به اطلاعات حساس بانکی و انجام معاملات بالقوه از طرف آنها هستند. (مرتبط: بانک زدایی سیاسی در بزرگترین بانک های آمریکا بیداد می کند، ادعاهای تحقیقات فدرال) گابریل باوم، سخنگوی سیتی به DCNF گفت: «برای کمک به حفاظت از حساب‌ها و اطلاعات مشتریان، ما به عوامل یا دستیاران هوش مصنوعی شخص ثالث اجازه ورود به حساب مشتری یا انجام معاملات مستقیم در پلت‌فرم‌های بانکداری دیجیتالی ما را نمی‌دهیم.» با این حال، مشتریان می‌توانند به مجوزهای دسترسی محدود و فقط خواندنی به اطلاعات حساب‌هایشان که با Citium باز اضافه شده است، ادامه دهند. ولز فارگو همچنین تأیید کرد که اقداماتی را برای محدود کردن دسترسی غیرمجاز انجام داده است. سخنگوی شرکت به DCNF گفت: «ولز فارگو اقداماتی را برای جلوگیری از دسترسی عوامل غیرمجاز به حساب‌های مشتریان انجام داده است.» شما باید عقب افتاده باشید تا به هوش مصنوعی دسترسی مستقیم به حساب‌های بانکی خود بدهید. این واقعیت که این فناوری 10 ثانیه پیش اختراع شد و در حال حاضر بسیاری از مردم مایل به استفاده از آن هستند

news.originalContent:
(Photo by J. David Ake/Getty Images)

As Nashville, Tennessee’s luxury housing market booms, middle-class residents are suffering from high housing costs and struggling to purchase homes.

Attracted by the lack of income and inheritance taxes, the ultra-wealthy have quickly moved to Nashville, and its luxury housing market is thriving, Bloomberg reported. Vying for homes in the Volunteer State, these elites are driving up prices and leaving longtime middle-class residents to deal with a high cost of living.

The median age of a first-time homebuyer in the United States is now 40 years old, and Nashville is no different, according to Greater Nashville Realtors. While Nashville’s policymakers have expanded efforts to improve affordability, the jury is out on whether new changes will help the city’s middle class become homeowners.

The prices of homes in Nashville have more than doubled since 2014, and baby boomer-aged people residing without children own 25% of family-sized homes in Nashville, according to Axios Nashville. Despite making up only 20% of the population, baby boomers hold over 50% of the household wealth in the United States, giving them an advantage over younger people when purchasing homes.

While sales of Nashville homes valued under $1 million declined since 2025, those valued over $2 million sold 6% more, according to Axios.

“I know a property that sold in 2021 for $6 million. In 2026, it closed for over $18 million — and if they did any work, it wasn’t much,” luxury real estate agent Jamie Parson told Bloomberg.

Nashville has experienced a greater increase in sales of homes in the top 1% by price (or ultra-luxury homes) than any other metropolitan area, a 208% increase from 2017 to 2025, Bloomberg reported. Compare this to New York City, which has seen ultra-luxury home sales decrease by 39%. Parsons marketed a $33.5 million penthouse in downtown Nashville that attracted interest spanning all the way to Dubai, she told Bloomberg.

Average-income families are priced out of most of the newly developed housing. Nashville residents require an income of $128,119 per year to afford a median-priced home, according to Redfin analysis.

Democrat Mayor Freddie O’Connell has emphasized the city’s efforts to improve affordability, and the Metro Council recently voted to pass the largest affordable housing investment in Nashville’s history, Fox 17 Nashville reported. The measure included a $40 million grant to build and rehabilitate 1,100 homes for residents making under $93,000 a year.

O’Connell didn’t respond to the Daily Caller News Foundation’s request for comment. (RELATED: EXCLUSIVE: Here’s How Medicaid Is Actually Impacting US Healthcare Affordability)

The grant is managed through the Barnes Housing Trust Fund, which has invested $191 million into 39 nonprofits since its inception in 2013. The Barnes Fund is credited with the preservation and creation of over 6,000 homes in the Nashville area.

Most of these homes are for renters, however. Of the 6,563 homes that have benefited from public funding, 5,131 are designated as rental homes, according to the 2026 Barnes Housing Trust Fund Annual Report. Furthermore, the affordable housing initiative has created only 467 new for-sale homes since 2013.

To receive housing vouchers in Nashville, a household must be designated “very low-income” by Nashville’s Metropolitan Development and Housing Agency (MDHA). For example, a family of four would need to earn less than $58,000 a year in 2026 to qualify for government housing assistance.

The housing affordability crisis has transformed into an issue affecting more than just the working class, and more cities than just Nashville.

“45% of the 390 metropolitan statistical areas are so expensive that households require six-figure incomes to buy an average-priced home,” Valerie White, head of National Housing Strategic Initiatives, wrote. This trend has grown beyond California and other coastal locations like New York City that are typically associated with high housing costs. Now even Nashville, Asheville, Houston and Boise are among the many cities requiring well-over six-figure incomes to afford a home.

“It has become kind of exclusive to live here now. Money is power and the rich pay whatever they need to. And if you don’t have money, you don’t have a voice,” local Nashvillian reverend Kevin Riggs told Bloomberg.
news.content:
(عکس از J. David Ake/Getty Images)
بلومبرگ گزارش داد که با رونق بازار مسکن لوکس نشویل، تنسی، ساکنان طبقه متوسط از هزینه های بالای مسکن رنج می برند و برای خرید خانه با مشکل مواجه هستند. بلومبرگ گزارش داد که به دلیل کمبود مالیات بر درآمد و ارث، افراد فوق ثروتمند به سرعت به نشویل نقل مکان کرده اند و بازار مسکن لوکس آن در حال رونق است. این نخبگان با رقابت برای خانه‌ها در ایالت داوطلب، قیمت‌ها را بالا می‌برند و ساکنان قدیمی طبقه متوسط ​​را مجبور می‌کنند تا با هزینه‌های بالای زندگی دست و پنجه نرم کنند. به گفته Realtors Greater Nashville، میانگین سنی یک خریدار خانه برای اولین بار در ایالات متحده اکنون 40 سال است و نشویل تفاوتی ندارد. در حالی که سیاست‌گذاران نشویل تلاش‌های خود را برای بهبود مقرون‌به‌صرفه گسترش داده‌اند، هیئت منصفه در مورد اینکه آیا تغییرات جدید به طبقه متوسط ​​شهر کمک می‌کند تا صاحب خانه شوند یا خیر، بررسی نشده است. قیمت خانه‌ها در نشویل از سال 2014 بیش از دو برابر شده است، و طبق گفته‌های آکسیوشویل، افرادی که در سنین کودکی هستند که بدون فرزند زندگی می‌کنند، مالک 25 درصد خانه‌های خانوادگی در نشویل هستند. علیرغم اینکه فقط 20 درصد جمعیت را تشکیل می‌دهند، بچه‌های بوم بیش از 50 درصد از ثروت خانوار در ایالات متحده را در اختیار دارند و به آنها امتیازی نسبت به افراد جوان در هنگام خرید خانه می‌دهد. در حالی که فروش خانه‌های نشویل به ارزش کمتر از 1 میلیون دلار از سال 2025 کاهش یافته است، آن‌هایی که بیش از 2 میلیون دلار ارزش دارند، 6 درصد بیشتر فروخته می‌شوند. در سال 2026، با قیمت بیش از 18 میلیون دلار بسته شد - و اگر آنها کاری انجام دادند، کار زیادی نبود.

سباستین لکورنو، نخست‌وزیر فرانسه، در شبکه‌های اجتماعی نوشت که این تیراندازی در منطقه تراپ (Trappes) در غرب پاریس رخ داده و آن را یک حادثه «بسیار جدی» توصیف کرد.

او افزود که مظنون این حمله دستگیر شده و در بازداشت پلیس است.

به گزارش خبرگزاری فرانسه، یک منبع پلیس گفت که روز جمعه ۲۳ اکتبر (اول آبان) مردی از داخل یک خودرو اقدام به تیراندازی کرده و ساعاتی بعد، حوالی ساعت ۱۰:۳۰ صبح به وقت محلی، در شهری نزدیک محل حادثه دستگیر شده است.

رسانه‌های فرانسه از احتمال افزایش شمار مجروحان گزارش می‌دهند. یک رسانه محلی گزارش کرده که یکی از مجروحان یک کودک ۱۲ ساله است که مورد اصابت هشت گلوله قرار گرفته است.

علی رابح، شهردار تراپ نیز در شبکه‌های اجتماعی نوشت که صبح جمعه «فردی از داخل یک خودرو به سمت چندین نفر تیراندازی کرد.»

آقای رابح به یک رسانه محلی گفت که فرد مسلح «بی‌هدف» در چندین محله «تردد» می‌کرد و «بدون هدف شلیک می‌کرد.»

به گفته آقای رابح، ظاهرا هدف فرد مهاجم این بوده که «تا حد امکان تلفات بیشتری ایجاد کند.»

گزیده‌ای از مهم‌ترین خبرها، گزارش‌های میدانی و گفت‌وگوهای اختصاصی را هر هفته در ایمیل خود دریافت کنید.

شهردار تراپ همچنین گفت که در جریان این تیراندازی، یک مرکز درمانی، یک پمپ‌بنزین و چندین خودرو هدف اصابت گلوله قرار گرفته‌اند.

یک مقام پلیس محلی گفت که فرد مظنون از «یک سلاح نیمه‌خودکار قدیمی» استفاده کرده و به صورت رگباری تیراندازی کرده است.

روزنامه لو پاریزین گزارش می‌دهد که قدمت این سلاح به دوران جنگ جهانی دوم بازمی‌گردد.

رابه اظهار داشت که تیرانداز در جریان این اقدامات، به یک مرکز درمانی، یک پمپ‌بنزین و چندین خودرو شلیک کرده است.

دفتر ملی دادستانی ضدتروریسم فرانسه اعلام کرد که رسیدگی به این حادثه را بر عهده گرفته است. به گفته این نهاد، به نظر می‌رسد این حادثه «قتل در ارتباط با یک اقدام تروریستی» باشد. این نهاد همچنین می‌گوید که تحقیقاتش شامل مواردی همچون «در اختیار داشتن سلاح رده آ» و «تبانی با یک گروه تروریستی به منظور اقدام به جنایت علیه اشخاص» می‌شود.

به گفته نخست‌وزیر فرانسه، دفتر دادستانی ملی ضدتروریسم اعلام کرده است که وضعیت را تحت نظارت دارد و «تمام منابع نیروهای امنیتی و دستگاه قضایی به محل اعزام شده‌اند.»

لوران نونز، وزیر کشور فرانسه، در مسیر سفر به محل حادثه، گفت که این حادثه «شبیه به یک یورش مرگبار» به نظر می‌رسد. او با این حال تاکید کرد که انگیزه مهاجم تا این لحظه مشخص نیست.

به گزارش رسانه‌های محلی، فرد مظنون که ۳۹ سال دارد، برای پلیس شناخته‌شده بود، اما نام او در سوابق سرویس‌های اطلاعاتی فرانسه وجود نداشت.

نیکولا دنویل، شهردار لا وری‌یر، فرد مظنون را «دارای ظاهری اروپایی» توصیف کرد.

امانوئل مکرون، رئیس‌جمهور فرانسه، ضمن ابراز «تأثر عمیق» و همدردی با قربانیان، افزود: «در این مصیبت هولناک، مردم فرانسه در کنار آنها ایستاده است.»

این تیراندازی در حالی رخ می‌دهد که فرانسه شاهد تنش‌های زیادی است.

این کشور اخیرا شاهد اعتراضات سراسری و صحنه‌های خشونت بار درگیری معترضان با نیروهای پلیس بوده است.

مقام‌های فرانسه اعلام کردند که از زمان شروع ناآرامی‌ها، بیش از ۲۵۰۰ نفر بازداشت شده‌اند. دست یکی از معترضان هم با نارنجک کنترل جمعیت پلیس قطع شد.

حدود ۱۰۰۰ مامور پلیس هم زخمی شدند.

طی این ناآرامی‌ها، فروشگاه‌ها هم غارت شدند و برآورد می‌شود که حدود ۱۵۰۰ مغازه و کسب‌وکار غارت و تخریب شده‌اند.

اعتراض‌ها ابتدا در ماه گذشته میلادی با درخواست دانش‌آموزان برای بهبود شرایط مدارس آغاز شد، اما با افزایش شمار شرکت‌کنندگان در تظاهرات و مشارکت اتحادیه‌های کارگری و گروه‌های مختلف اعتراضی، دامنه وسیع‌تری از درخواست‌ها را در بر گرفت.
